message:
fix(p4-1): restore checks versions and immutable draft recovery

Normalize legacy source versions only in non-release checks, rejecting explicit
suffixes and arithmetic overflow. Resume uniquely identified unpublished drafts
without inventing a tag, verify existing bytes, and recheck tags before publishing.

Add discriminating red/green Bash and production-client regressions. Synchronize
only the already-authorized P4-1 readiness registration and exact governance set.
Keep prior CI failures and real-environment NOT_RUN boundaries explicit.
